column.name: formatted_age_dob
column.path: iif(birthDate.exists(), 'Age: ' + iif((today() - birthDate) < 30 'days', (today() - birthDate).toString() + ' days', iif((today() - birthDate) < 730 'days', ((today() - birthDate) / 30.4375).round(0).toString() + ' months', ((today() - birthDate) / 365.25).floor().toString() + ' years')) + ' (DOB: ' + birthDate + ')', 'Age unknown')
